EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART IV (A) - PROVINCIAL COUNCILS
Appointments & C., by the Governors
1A
UVA PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Appointments made by the Governor of the Uva Province
I, hereby notify that the following appointments have been approved by Hon. C. Nanda Mathew, Governor of Uva Provinceunder Section 32(1) of the Provincial Council Act, No. 42 of 1987.

01.Dr. P. W. W. Dissanayake, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Ayurvedic Medical Service, to act as Medical Officer ofthe Bibila Medagama Ayurveda Hospital, in addition to his permanent post, with effect from the date 07.07.2014.

02.Mr. W. M. Nimal Weerasinghe, Retired Officer of the Sri Lanka Educational Administrative Service, reappointedon contract basis as Deputy Director (Education) to the Ministry of Education and Local Government of UvaProvince, from the date 14.08.2014 till the appointment of a Permanent Officer or up to 13.08.2015.

03.Mrs. Gnana Rathnayake, Retired Officer of the Sri Lanka Administative Service, reappointed on contract basis asMunicipal Commissioner of the Badulla Municipal Council, from the date 29.08.2014 till the appointment of aPermanent Officer or up to 31.12.2014.

04.Mr. R. M. Ananda Rathnayake, Class I officer of the Sri Lanka Educational Administrative Service, to perform theduties of the Director to Education of Uva Province, in addition to his permanent post, from the date 20.09.2014to 24.09.2014, till the return of Mr. R. M. P. Rathnayake, to the Island who is the Director to Education of UvaProvince.
H. M. SOMATHILAKA,Secretary to the Governor,
Uva Province.Office of the Uva Governor,King's Street,Badulla.
